fusions.name: Drawn on the Draught
fusions.desc: A pull of air that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets, draws out every affliction you have on it and deals 60% more damage for each one drawn.

fusions.name: Bitterness Exhaled
fusions.desc: Breathes out drawn poison in a cone 4 tiles long that deals 11 damage and leaves everything in it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Airing Out
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 poison conditions from you and every ally, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Not Yours to Keep
fusions.desc: Each affliction laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it instead, and you have 10% poison resistance.
